title: Flowering Symmetric Asymmetry
subtitle: A second Art Nouveau study — this time just about the flowers.
seo_title: Flowering Symmetric Asymmetry: Generative Art Nouveau Floral Abstractions
seo_description: A generative art nouveau collection exploring floral symmetry, flowing ornament, and luminous color fields with disciplined decorative balance.
thumb_alt: Floral abstractions with graceful symmetry and art nouveau line work, rendered in luminous color.

tiles: More reading on Art Nouveau and floral ornament
challenge: The more time I spent with Art Nouveau, the more I noticed how its floral work sits right on the edge between symmetry and asymmetry — almost perfectly balanced, but breathing. I wanted to try to land in that same narrow place.
approach: I kept reading about Art Nouveau's ornamental tradition, then drafted a lot of floral variations, looking for the ones where the symmetry felt alive rather than rigid. I kept the five that felt like they had that specific kind of grace.
result: A small, luminous set that I really enjoyed making. They're available as prints for anyone who loves a beautifully drawn flower.
role_headline: Floral Motifs Shaped by Generative Symmetry
